notes: The deterministic Top-20 retains its single directly-supported-path reservation slot.

Rust contributes conservative declaration symbols without inferred call edges. The scanner consumes an optional UTF-8 BOM, preserves comment token boundaries, masks script shebangs, normalizes XID-compatible identifiers to NFC, accepts Rust 2024 safe foreign functions, distinguishes control-flow negation from delimiter-backed macro calls, skips outer attributes and macro_rules or macro 2.0 token trees across line breaks, recognizes declarations whose keyword and name span lines, recognizes multiple declarations per line, records default associated types, and computes declaration lines and macro searches in bounded forward passes. TypeScript, TSX, C, and C++ remain file-only until a parser-backed implementation is available.
